title: Tankbook remote config document
description: A signed config document served by GET /v1/config (docs/API.md, docs/CONFIG.md). Validated against this schema AT PUBLISH TIME on the server, so a malformed document never reaches a device. Clients additionally verify the Ed25519 signature before applying anything.

version.description: Monotonic document version; clients never apply a version below the one they hold (rollback protection, docs/CONFIG.md).

issuedAt.description: When the document was issued (ISO-8601 UTC).

notAfter.description: End of the validity window (default 90 days, docs/CONFIG.md). An expired document is discarded in favour of bundled defaults.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional API base URL override. HTTPS only; the client additionally enforces a compiled-in host allowlist before adopting it (docs/CONFIG.md 'Guardrails on apiBaseUrl').

tier2OnDeviceLLM.description: Kill switch for on-device LLM extraction. true = enabled.

tier3CloudFallback.description: Kill switch for cloud extraction fallback. true = enabled.

onDeviceLLM.description: Monthly request cap for the on-device tier.

cloudFallback.description: Monthly request cap for the cloud fallback tier.

ocrConfidenceThreshold.description: Confidence gate below which OCR output dims toward manual review (docs/SCHEMA.md ExtractionMeta).

minSchemaVersion.description: Minimum payload schema version clients must speak; the general default before the first /sync/pull (docs/SYNC.md, docs/CONFIG.md).

rates.description: Reference data pack version for exchange rates.

catalog.description: Reference data pack version for the vehicle catalog.

text.description: Plain text only - no HTML, no markup, no arbitrary URLs (docs/CONFIG.md 'Defence in depth': the maintenance notice is inert). The pattern rejects <, > and & so a notice can only ever render as plain text.

rolloutSalt.description: Per-release salt mixed with a device hash to decide flag rollout buckets (docs/CONFIG.md).
